technical.summary: Early momentum signals (PPO crossover, rising RSI, OBV strength) show potential recovery, but price remains below all key moving averages with negative MACD histogram, limiting conviction for a high-probability swing entry.

fundamental.summary: ACN shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signals, zero government contract activity, no lobbying engagement, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 29 days present elevated risk with no offsetting fundamental catalysts.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (10/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but mixed congressional activity (1 sale, 2 small purchases by non-senior members) and absent news sentiment provide no confirmation.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (378.4) combined with flat yield curve and approaching earnings (29 days) creates highly unfavourable macro conditions for ACN trading.

debate.key_bull_argument: Early PPO crossover, rising OBV, and supertrend bullish with extreme fear sentiment (10/100) create contrarian setup near support (257.98) for potential mean-reversion bounce.
debate.key_bear_argument: Price remains below all major moving averages with deeply negative MACD histogram, zero fundamental catalysts, crisis-level VIX (378.4), earnings risk in 29 days, and no institutional/insider conviction—technical signals lack conviction in hostile macro environment.
